name: macromapper
description: Read and manage MacroMapper meals, foods, proposals, and notifications with explicit write confirmations.

interface.longDescription: Read your MacroMapper meals, food catalog, proposals, and notifications. Review explicit previews before confirmed changes. Paid AI estimates require their separate permission and explicit confirmation. Uses your existing MacroMapper account and the OAuth permissions you select. Nutrition information is not medical or prescriptive dietary advice.
defaultPrompt: Find foods in my MacroMapper catalog.
Help me review a meal before saving it.
